profile.headline: Software Engineer at DocuSign
profile.summary: Competitive, astute, and dedicated professional competent in pursuing and applying education and expertise in technology to manage the complete life cycle of software development process, from research and design to implementation, training, and support. Experienced with object oriented software analysis, design, and implementation using modern integrated development environments. Self-motivated and capable of working independently or in a team with demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks to accomplish maximum results, timely completion of projects, and ability to address organizational problems with innovative solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪Created platform to manage machine learning activities including model/data set configurations, training, and monitoring. Services were built in Java, using Spring Boot Framework & Spring Data.
▪Developed rule engine UI for our Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) product. The UI was created using JSP's with KnockoutJS, jQuery.
▪Mentored engineers on software development and best practices. Mentees were able to quickly take ownership of their own projects and initiatives.
▪My experience as a Full Stack developer allowed me to work on different projects and assist where needed. Balancing competing priorities and tight deadlines while working on multiple project teams simultaneously.

positions.title: Associate Consultant- Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Developed core service and supporting microservices to automate merchandise price selection for enterprise retailer 
▪ Working on projects as Full Stack Developer. Developing in Java and Spring Boot for the back end, and using technology and framework such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ReactJS and JQuery for the front end. 
▪ Perform analysis of existing or new processes to determine how to best enable and implement. Agile development and the proper utilization of XP practices to achieve development goals

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
▪ Researched highly-parallel data querying infrastructure. 
▪ Reviewed and analyzed code for testing and debugging.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helping the coordinator run the center which served as an area where kids could go after school to get help on homework or hangout with friends in a safe environment. My duties included assisting the children on their homework, helping organize the center as well as communicating with the parents if any questions needed answering.
I worked on home repairs-preserve a home, as well as general construction of new homes
